interface.shortDescription: Design engineering work system for humans and AI agents: frame, model, build, verify, polish, then compound what was learned.
interface.longDescription: Compound Design is a work system for design engineers building web applications with AI agents. It runs a loop — frame the problem, model the behaviour, build it, verify it against what was decided, polish what works, then capture the one learning worth keeping — with specialist reviewers for interface craft, motion and user-facing AI, and an evidence system that keeps claims inside what has actually been measured.
defaultPrompt: Frame the problem before we build this
Review this interface for what materially costs the user
What did this work teach that is worth keeping?
